
### NS-3 logging  {.smaller}


* NS3 logging tools 

   * [https://www.nsnam.org/docs/manual/html/logging-asserts.html](https://www.nsnam.org/docs/manual/html/logging-asserts.html)

* doing logging: 
```
// at top of file
NS_LOG_COMPONENT_DEFINE("SomeLabel");
...
// when you want to log
NS_LOG_INFO("value of x=" << x);
    // INFO could be DEBUG, ERROR, ... too

```

* enabling logging: 

   * in C++: <code>LogComponentEnable("SomeLabel", LOG_LEVEL_DEBUG)</code>
   * command-line: <code>NS_LOG="SomeLabel=debug" ./ns3 ...</code>
